run.label: LIVE — Muse Wonder
run.text: Allocate Substitute covers 70 units for two jobs using 70 of 100 verified substitute units, completing in 35 hours at $3,115 incremental cost ($2,975 labor plus $140 material premium), ahead of the 36- and 48-hour due windows (ev-sub-stock, ev-recv-qty). The certificate shows 120 units while receiving posted 80, so the held alloy remains unavailable and the 40-unit gap remains unresolved (ev-cert-qty, ev-recv-qty). If Wait for Replenishment were chosen instead, incremental cost would be $0 but completion would extend to 83 hours (48-hour replenishment plus 35 production hours), missing both due windows. Split Capacity is not available because it requires at least two online compatible cells and CELL-MILL-2 is unavailable. These comparisons assume quantities follow the current certificate, receiving, and stock records, cell costs follow the rates in the current records, and substitute use is limited to verified available stock.

board.summary: Blockers: the original ALLOY-A lot remains on hold despite receiving post R1 showing quantity=80 each (ev-recv-qty), and no supplier messaging is permitted, so recovery cannot use that lot or contact the supplier. Evidence: ev-sub-stock verifies MAT-ALLOY-B on-hand=100 each and not held, covering the 70 impacted units; allocation uses only this verified stock on CELL-MILL-1 for 35 hours within the 35-hour finish window. Draft tasks below are for human approval.
